title: PM Fils-Aimé Announces Dialysis Cost Cut at OFATMA Hospital, Les Cayes
detail: Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé announced on August 14, 2026 that dialysis session costs at OFATMA Hospital in Les Cayes would be reduced from 15,000 to 5,000 gourdes, with further reductions planned, as part of limited government efforts to ease healthcare costs amid Haiti's economic contraction and collapsed public health infrastructure in gang-affected regions.
